title: Exactness and quotient of one constructed subgroup inclusion
statement: Let K, Ks and Omega be fields in universe u, with compatible embeddings K -> Ks -> Omega [def-pd-separable-closure], and Omega algebraically closed. Let G=Gal(Ks/K) with the Krull topology, let H be an open subgroup of G, and set L=(Ks)^H. A fixed-field comparison C consists of an equivalence E from abelian etale sheaves on Spec L [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] to discrete continuous integer H-modules [def-exc-discrete-modules-category], a natural additive isomorphism j from the underlying group of E(F) to the geometric stalk F_p at the point p:Spec Omega -> Spec L induced by L -> Ks -> Omega [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], and the following action compatibility. For every F, g in H, K-automorphism tau of Omega extending g on Ks, etale L-scheme X, pointed lifts x,x' of p with x'=Spec(tau) followed by x, and section z of F on X, j_F(g*j_F^{-1}(germ_x(z)))=germ_x'(z). Let T be a scheme in universe u and e:Spec L ~= T an isomorphism. For a specified discrete H-module V define P_C(V)=(e.inv)^*(E.inverse(V)) using inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let R be a discrete continuous integer G-representation with underlying abelian group R.V in universe u+1. Restrict it to H with the same action. For an H-invariant additive subgroup B of R.V, write V_B for its canonical integer submodule with this restricted action; its underlying elements are exactly x in B. For additive subgroups A,B of R.V put N=A.toIntSubmodule.comap(B.toIntSubmodule.subtype). Let Q_{A,B} be the discrete H-module with underlying group B.toIntSubmodule/N and trivial H-action. Let A and B be H-invariant additive subgroups with A contained in B. Assume for every g in H and x in B that g*x-x belongs to A. Construct the equivariant inclusion V_A -> V_B using the subtype inclusion. Apply E.inverse and (e.inv)^* to it, obtaining f:P_C(V_A)->P_C(V_B). Let S be the specific short complex with X1=P_C(V_A), X2=P_C(V_B), X3=cokernel(f), first map f and second map the cokernel projection. Then S is short exact and S.X3 is isomorphic to P_C(Q_{A,B}). No prime, finiteness, chain, or terminal sheaf is assumed.

proof.text: The subtype inclusion is injective, hence mono in Rep and in the full subcategory of discrete continuous representations. Define the equivariant map to the explicit trivial quotient via N.mkQ; equivariance is g*x-x in A. Forget to integer modules. ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff reduces exactness to lifting a quotient-kernel element: Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero says its value lies in A, so use that same value as an A element. ShortComplex.exact_map_iff_of_faithful reflects this exactness to Rep. The quotient projection is epi by Rep.epi_iff_surjective and N.mkQ_surjective; Exact.gIsCokernel gives its cokernel universal property. The fully faithful inclusion reflects this colimit into discrete continuous representations.

Compose C.inverse with Etale.upperStar along e.inv. This functor preserves monomorphisms and cokernels: C.inverse is an equivalence and upperStar preserves finite limits and colimits. The complex formed with its mapped inclusion and cokernel projection is short exact by ShortComplex.exact_cokernel. Map the quotient cokernel cofork through this composite, and identify its colimit point with the chosen sheaf cokernel by coconePointUniqueUpToIso. This gives exactly the specified associated quotient sheaf. No comparison action hypothesis, inverse-image composition theorem, or abelian structure theorem for discrete representations is used.

theorem primarySheafSequence_shortExact
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω] [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (H : OpenSubgroup (Gal(Ks/K))) (C : PrimaryFixedFieldEquivalence K Ks H)
    (hC : PrimaryFixedFieldComparison K Ks H Ω C)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (e : Spec (.of (IntermediateField.fixedField H.toSubgroup)) ≅ T)
    (R : Rep.DiscreteContinuousRep.{0, u, u + 1} ℤ (Gal(Ks/K)))
    (A B : AddSubgroup R.obj.V) (hle : A ≤ B)
    (hA : ∀ (g : H.toSubgroup) (x : R.obj.V), x ∈ A →
      R.obj.ρ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) x ∈ A)
    (hB : ∀ (g : H.toSubgroup) (x : R.obj.V), x ∈ B →
      R.obj.ρ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) x ∈ B)
    (htriv : ∀ (g : H.toSubgroup) (x : R.obj.V), x ∈ B →
      R.obj.ρ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) x - x ∈ A) :
    (primarySheafSequence K Ks H Ω C T e R A B hle hA hB).ShortExact ∧
    Nonempty ((primarySheafSequence K Ks H Ω C T e R A B hle hA hB).X₃ ≅
      primaryAssociatedSheaf K Ks H Ω C T e (primaryTrivialQuotient K Ks H R A B))
